description: Settings registry of the AMU KPI Monitoring System. Only settings declared here can be stored or read. Every setting is stored in the system_setting table: scripts/seedSettings.js (npm run seed:settings, also run on every server start) creates missing rows with `default`; saved values are never overwritten. `public: true` settings are returned without login by GET /api/v1/settings/public. Types: text, email, number (min, max, integer), boolean, enum (options), json (validator), file (a File id), datetime.

groups.label: Branding
groups.description: Institution identity shown on the login page, header and reports.

settings.label: University name
settings.description: Full institution name

settings.label: Short name
settings.description: Abbreviation used in compact layouts

settings.label: System name
settings.description: Product name shown in the browser title and header

settings.label: Logo
settings.description: Uploaded logo image (File id from POST /api/v1/files/upload)

settings.label: Support contact email
settings.description: Shown to users who need help (e.g. on the login page)

settings.label: Time zone
settings.description: Time zone used for deadlines and reminders

settings.label: Display calendar
settings.description: Calendar used to display dates in the UI

settings.label: Fiscal year start month
settings.description: Gregorian month in which a new fiscal year normally starts (7 = July, Ethiopian fiscal year)

groups.label: KPI & Scoring
groups.description: Defaults for KPI planning and performance scoring.

settings.label: Official score basis
settings.description: Which achievement is the official weighted score. Both are always calculated and kept

settings.label: Cap overachievement
settings.description: Cap official scores at the maximum score. The raw value is always kept

settings.label: Maximum score
settings.description: Highest official achievement score when overachievement is capped

settings.label: Contract total weight
settings.description: Default total the KPI weights of a new performance contract must reach

settings.label: Missing results
settings.description: PENDING leaves a missing result unscored and the total provisional. AUTO_FILL_ZERO records 0 and marks the row as auto-filled

settings.label: Verify baselines before approval
settings.description: A known baseline must be verified before its assignment can be approved

settings.label: Separate approver
settings.description: The person who prepared an assignment or change request cannot also approve it

settings.label: Default over-allocation cap
settings.description: Default over-allocation cap for new KPI assignments when cascading

groups.label: Reporting & Deadlines
groups.description: Rules for submitting KPI reports in reporting periods.

settings.label: Submission window
settings.description: Days after a reporting period ends until the report is due (used when a period has no explicit deadline)

settings.label: Low performance alert
settings.description: When an approved result is below this achievement, the office above is alerted. 0 turns the alert off

settings.label: Deadline reminders
settings.description: Days before the deadline on which offices with unsubmitted reports are reminded

settings.label: Allow late submission
settings.description: Whether offices may still submit after the deadline (within the grace period)

settings.label: Late submission grace period
settings.description: Days after the deadline during which late submissions are accepted and flagged as late

settings.label: Lock reports after deadline
settings.description: Automatically lock unsubmitted reports once the deadline (plus grace period) has passed

settings.label: Require evidence
settings.description: Require at least one evidence document on each reported result before a report can be submitted

groups.label: Login Security
groups.description: Protection against password and verification code guessing.

settings.label: Failed attempts allowed
settings.description: Failed password or verification code attempts before that account is blocked from that address

settings.label: Lockout period
settings.description: Minutes the failed attempts are remembered and the block lasts

groups.label: System Status
groups.description: Availability of the system. In maintenance mode only university-wide settings managers can use the API.

settings.label: Maintenance mode
settings.description: Take the system offline for everyone except university-wide settings managers

settings.label: Maintenance message
settings.default: The system is under maintenance. Please try again later.
settings.description: Message shown to users while maintenance mode is on

settings.label: Expected end of maintenance
settings.description: Optional estimated end time shown to users (ISO date-time)
